tools.name: score_writing
tools.description: Use this when a student pastes an essay or summary for a PTE, IELTS, TOEFL, LanguageCert, MET or CELPIP writing task and wants a score. Returns marks out of the exam task maximum, a score and one line of feedback for each marking criterion, and the top improvements. Pass the questionId from practice

tools.name: start_diagnostic
tools.description: Use when a student does not know which exam to take (diagnostic) or knows the exam and wants a starting baseline (placement). Returns a link to a free test on the site; do not try to run the test in chat.

tools.name: check_read_aloud
tools.description: Use when a student has read a Read Aloud passage aloud and you have the transcript of what they said (for example from voice mode) but no audio. Compares the words said against the passage: omitted, inserted and substituted words and a word-accuracy percentage. CONTENT ONLY — pronunciation, fluency

tools.name: speak_practice
tools.description: Use whenever a student asks for a PTE Read Aloud or Describe Image to practise, even without mentioning recording or scores. Lets them practise the speaking task and get pronunciation and fluency scores. Shows a recorder card; desktop web only today. Do not use for scoring text.

tools.name: recorder_start
tools.description: Reserve a recording slot and get an upload URL. Called by the speaking recorder card only.

tools.name: recorder_confirm
tools.description: Confirm the upload and queue it for scoring. Called by the speaking recorder card only.

tools.name: recorder_result
tools.description: Read the scoring status and scores for a recording. Called by the speaking recorder card only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "copilot" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: practice_question, check_read_aloud, recorder_start · Public sink: recorder_start, recorder_confirm · Destructive: start_diagnostic.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: practice_question, check_read_aloud, recorder_start · Public sink: recorder_start, recorder_confirm · Destructive: start_diagnostic

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
